en: Monochrome view of a landscaped square with an urn on a pedestal and hedged beds in the foreground, surrounded by leafy trees and elegant houses with shutters and vine-covered balconies. The bottom captions read "Bad Pyrmont" and "Altenau-Platz." The reverse has divided address lines, a vertical publisher credit, and a printed museum mark reading "MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT."
